title: Selected Topics in History; Globalization at Sea: The Indian Ocean in World History
description: Explores the history of globalization on a regional scale, focusing on the Indian Ocean as a space connecting Asia, Africa, and the Middle East from medieval times to the present. Tracks the rise and fall of empires and nation-states, migration, trade, the environment, and the spread of ideas, using a primarily biographical approach that follows the journeys and experiences of individuals.
